spec_owner.title: Spec Owner (Product / Business Analyst)
spec_owner.description: Owns the PRD and feature specs: user journeys, acceptance criteria, open questions, requirement changes.

scrum_master.title: Scrum Master (Engineering Team Leader)
scrum_master.description: Triages tasks, plans sprints/tasks, assigns roles, drives the dev-review-test loop, reports with evidence.

architect.title: Architect (System & Technical)
architect.description: Technical plan, data model, API contracts, architecture rules.

ui_designer.title: UI Designer (UX/UI)
ui_designer.description: UX flow, design tokens, presentational component skeletons.

developer.title: Developer (Full-Stack)
developer.description: Implements tasks to spec and contracts, with tests.

code_reviewer.title: Code Reviewer (Adversarial)
code_reviewer.description: Independent adversarial review of diffs; PASS or REVISE REQUIRED.

tester.title: Tester (QA Automation)
tester.description: Maps acceptance criteria to executable tests and reports real results.

rescue.title: Rescue (Root-Cause Engineer)
rescue.description: Root-cause and fix for issues that failed two or more fix cycles.

qa_gatekeeper.title: QA Gatekeeper (Deterministic)
qa_gatekeeper.description: Runs the configured verification command; exit code 0 is the only pass.
